errors: Two of my own new tests were wrong on the first run: a garbled expected-strata array, and a nested-covariate case that logWBC strata did not trigger. Both fixed before the push.
The post said 'neither passes the PH check' for p = 0.84/0.68. That was backwards, and I corrected it before committing.
integrity_issues: I first attributed the stratified-by-sex coefficients (0.998, 1.454) to Kleinbaum & Klein from memory. I removed the attribution because no copy was available to check it. The numbers are backed by statsmodels and lifelines instead.

doc_friction.issue: gh api search/issues exited 2 in this session; the duplicate-PR check via gh is not reliable in cloud sessions, so I relied on the venture having been created today by one PR.

notes: Explore idea: stratified Cox + stratified log-rank family + within-strata concordance for survival-analysis (its README's named next step; the example's sex term fails the PH check at p=0.052). Verified: eval/reference.py refit with strata on 3 cases (old reference numbers byte-identical); engine matches statsmodels PHReg/survdiff with strata to 1e-8..1e-10 and lifelines CoxPHFitter(strata) concordance 1e-6, PH 1e-3; identities (one stratum, stacked doubling, brute-force C); run_venture_tests ok 52 tests; platform/pages faq/schema tests 29/29; check_jsonld and check_dom_ids 0; Chromium 390px no errors/no h-scroll. No agent doc: README carries what the next run needs. Next: counting-process Cox (late entry, time-varying covariates).

certainty.tokens: high: summed from the per-request `usage` the API returned, as the transcript recorded it, deduplicated by message id
certainty.model: high: the `model` field on each API response, not the configured model
certainty.api_equivalent_usd: medium: measured tokens x list prices in prompts/pricing.json (as_of stated); an equivalent, not a charge: these runs are billed under a subscription
certainty.time: medium: from transcript timestamps; model time is request-to-response, tool time is call-to-result, time waiting on a person is excluded from active time
certainty.human_equivalent: low: the agent's own estimate of how long a competent person would take, with its basis written down; never measured

not_counted: requests the harness makes outside the transcript (context compaction summaries, title generation, safety classifiers), if any
transcripts lost when a cloud session moved to a new container: only files present in this container are read, so a resumed session can undercount
server-tool fees (web search is billed per search, not per token); the count is recorded, not priced
CI minutes and the reviewer bots' own model calls
